name: Nyáregyháza (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyáregyháza: a crowned blue shield with a white arm holding a sabre and a star, with blue and red mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyáregyháza arms with crown and mantling
